# Public source package

The existing repository policy excludes the tuned `adaptive_params.h` header.
It is therefore omitted from the repository root and from both source copies
under this version directory. Building the complete engine requires that private
header. Compiled engine files are unchanged from the locally tested 0.8.5 release.
The source hash inventory records the tested local source, including the digest
of that omitted header. No private header contents are published.

The checksum files here describe the public file set. Local-only source backup
paths are omitted from the public manifest.
